title: Many lines of evidence
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Different probes have different assumptions and sensitivities. Consistent results can strengthen a model, while remaining uncertainties and potential shared biases still matter.
